label: Comprehensive real estate holding tax: rate band for individuals with up to two homes
unit: % of the tax base, upper end of the band
appliesTo: Individuals holding two homes or fewer, on the housing portion of the tax
why: Kept as its own series because the heavy rates for larger holdings are a different structure, and because the band matters more than the top rate: an ordinary owner sits near the bottom of it, not the top. In a holding-period model this is a recurring annual cost, so an error here compounds over every year of the projection rather than appearing once.

history.source: Comprehensive Real Estate Holding Tax Act
history.note: Progressive by tax base for an individual holding two homes or fewer. The tax base is the aggregate published price less the deduction, multiplied by the fair market value ratio — so the effective rate against market value is materially lower than the headline. Companies and larger holdings are taxed under a separate structure.
